references.notes: Flush covered back with individual lens, flash and mic openings. Official 16e drawing verifies shared phone dimensions with 17e; separate reference case uses an exposed Action-button opening, covered volume/power controls and USB-C. Case thickness, clearances and printable compatibility await an exact blank. This reference has no built-in magnets; no MagSafe performance is claimed.
